name: Rajib Sarkar
review:
Decathlon Sports at Viviana Mall is a haven for sports enthusiasts and casual shoppers alike. The store's vast layout is well-organized, offering a wide range of sports equipment, apparel, and accessories for almost every sport imaginable. From running and cycling to yoga and hiking, Decathlon ensures that every customer finds what they need.

What truly stands out is the knowledgeable and friendly staff. They are always ready to assist, whether you're a seasoned athlete looking for specific gear or a beginner needing guidance. Their expertise and willingness to help make the shopping experience smooth and enjoyable.

The quality of the products is top-notch. Decathlon's in-house brands offer great value for money, combining durability with affordability. The store also regularly updates its inventory, ensuring that the latest products are available. It's refreshing to see a store that prioritizes both quality and variety.

Another highlight is the hands-on experience provided. The store often has areas where you can test out equipment, like bikes and treadmills, ensuring you are making informed purchases. This interactive aspect is particularly beneficial for those unsure about their choices.

The location within Viviana Mall adds to the convenience. Ample parking, a wide range of other stores, and dining options make it easy to spend an entire day here. Plus, the mall's central location is easily accessible from different parts of the city.

Overall, Decathlon Sports at Viviana Mall is a must-visit for anyone looking for sports gear. The combination of a vast product range, excellent customer service, and the convenience of being in a popular mall makes it a standout destination. Highly recommended!
